resources.string: The app needs access to your contacts so that you can view your contact list.
You have permanently denied access to your contacts. Please go to settings and enable the permission manually.
In order for us to find and delete duplicate contacts, the app needs permission to change the data.
The duplicate removal function is not available because access to the contact record is blocked. Please allow the editing of contacts in the device settings.
This permission will allow you to make calls to selected contacts at the touch of a button.
Calls are unavailable. To call contacts directly from the app, activate the phone call permission in the settings.
Are you sure you want to delete completely identical contacts? This action cannot be undone.
